source_documents.title: Aggregation Induced Emission and Nonlinear Optical Properties of an Intramolecular Charge-Transfer Compound

reference_evidence_units.quote: stable one-dimensional wire-like structures were precipitated
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Saturated THF cooled from 70 C to room temperature.
reference_evidence_units.statement: THF cooling affords wire-like aggregates; DCM under the same cooling procedure affords rods.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Morphology does not by itself establish a particular exciton mechanism.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the angle between the benzothiadiazole unit and the adjacent benzene ring is 26.6
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single crystal from THF/hexane diffusion; Figures 2a-c.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The crystal contains twisted molecules, antiparallel arrangements and several short heteroatom/hydrogen-bond contacts.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Static crystal structure is not confirmation of the legacy chemical graph.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the electron cloud on the LUMO orbital is mainly located on the benzothiadiazole ring and the nitro group
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Frontier orbitals support donor-to-benzothiadiazole/nitro CT, with HOMO mainly on dimethylaminophenyl.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state orbital localization is not a computed TICT pathway.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the solution of BTN in pure tetrahydrofuran did not emit light when excited at its maximum absorption wavelength of 514 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports negligible emission in THF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No numeric quantum yield or detection floor supplied.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The maximum fluorescence emission peaks range from 672 to 617 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Increasing hexane enhances emission with a blue shift from approximately 672 to 617 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvent polarity and aggregation co-vary; this cannot alone isolate packing.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the ICT band red-shifted gradually from 514 to 496, 494 and 492 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: The reported absorption values decrease from 514 to 492 nm, a blue shift confirmed by the figure.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source incorrectly calls this red-shifted and exchanges panel references in prose; values retained, direction corrected explicitly.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intramolecular charge transfer will be eliminated, and the emissions will be recovered.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose suppression of nonradiative CT in aggregates.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The claim that CT is eliminated is stronger than demonstrated; no time-resolved separation of states is shown.

reference_evidence_units.quote: some electrons are provided to offset the electron absorption ability of nitro groups
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aggregate hydrogen bonds and heteroatom contacts.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose contacts reduce the nitro group's electron-withdrawing effect and restore fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a qualitative electronic explanation, not directly measured electron donation or proof of PET.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Specific intermolecular contacts and aggregate morphology are proposed to modify nonradiative CT; this is weaker author interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the source's CT-quenching/suppression interpretation, without upgrading it to a demonstrated twisted-state geometry.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of internal motion established in this extraction; AIE or rigidity alone is not sufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Specific intermolecular contacts and aggregate morphology are proposed to modify nonradiative CT; this is weaker author interpretation.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain the source's CT-quenching/suppression interpretation, without upgrading it to a demonstrated twisted-state geometry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state mechanism established beyond generic changes in fluorescence intensity.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
